text: Hmm, let me think about that one. Yeah, I don't think any of those are it. I'm pretty sure the one I have is #876543210. Maybe it got mixed up somewhere? No worries, I can just give you the details of what I want to exchange.
zh: 嗯，让我想想。对，我不觉得那些中有对的。我确定我有的就是 #876543210。也许在某个地方搞混了？没关系，我可以直接给你我要换货的详情。
